title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 17.11 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8,…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab CE/EE versions from 17.11 up to but not including 19.3.9, 19.4 up to but not including 19.4.8, and 19.5 up to but not including 19.5.6 allowed unauthenticated users to read commit comments from private source forks via public project merge request discussions due to missing authorization checks. This issue has been remediated in the specified fixed versions.
